# The Board of Supervisors, Guangxi Beibu Gulf Bank Co., Ltd. Annual Report 2010

For the attention of all shareholders:

Commissioned by the Board of Supervisors, I present the report of the works of the Board of Supervisors in 2010 to the General Meeting of Shareholders, for your examination.

In 2010, the Board of Supervisors of the Bank, in accordance with the provisions of laws, regulations and Articles of Association, faithfully performed its duties. All Supervisors diligently discharged their duties; seriously supervised and examined finance, risk management and internal controls by attending the general meeting of shareholders, attending meetings of the Board of Directors and special committees thereunder as nonvoting delegates, by means of interview and communication with directors and members of senior management, and by the implementation of special examinations and research; continued to strengthen the supervision over the fulfillment of duties by the Board of Directors, senior management and members thereof, playing an active role in promoting the sound operation and healthy development of the Bank and in safeguarding the interests of all shareholders and depositors. The works of the Board of Supervisors in 2010 is reported as follows:

### 1. Performance of duties of the Board of Supervisors

(I) Strengthen self-building of the Board of Supervisors and continually improve the standard of supervision.

## 广西北部湾银行 2010 年年报

1. Further improve the working mechanisms of the Board of Supervisors and strengthen the supervisory functions.

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors, in accordance with Company Law, and the basic duties conferred by the Articles of Association of the Bank upon the Board of Supervisors, and relevant supervision requirements of regulatory departments, and in combination with research within the industry and with due research for the current situation of the Bank, formulated the System of Board of Supervisors on Interview (Trial), System of the Bank's Board of Supervisors on Enhancing Collection of Daily Supervision Information (Trial), System of Board of Supervisors in Inspection (Trial), Measures of Board of Supervisors on Audit of Directors and Senior Management upon Leaving (Trial), Measures of Board of Supervisors on Management of Duty Performance Files (Trial), Rules for Works of Board of Supervisors Office (Trial), and other systems; and proposed specific measures for enhancing the manner of supervision to strengthen the exchanges between the Board of Supervisors, Board of Directors and Senior Management, improving supervision over the duty performance of directors and senior management personnel, and standardizing the working mechanism of the Board of Supervisors, resulting in further strengthening of the supervisory functions of the Board of Supervisors. To improve the building of a corporate governance system of the Bank, the Board of Supervisors entrusted the collection and verification of the institutional framework of the Board of Supervisors to Wei Heng Law Firm, thus further enhancing the standardization and institutionalization of the operation of the Board of Supervisors.

2. Strengthen communication with the Board of Directors and senior management, understand and master trends in operations and management in a timely manner.

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors earnestly implemented an information reporting system with the Board of Directors and business management, ensuring that supervisors effectively understood the operation and management of the Bank in a timely manner. At each regular meeting of the Board of Supervisors, the Board of Supervisors invited members of Senior Management and responsible persons of relevant functional departments to make special reports pertaining to the Bank's financial management, risk management, internal control and compliance management and to accept the inquiries of supervisors; after each special investigation and research, the Board of Supervisors reported the situation to Senior Management and proposed suggestions regarding management issues in a timely manner; according to the requirement in performance of their duties, the Board of Supervisors took the initiative in interviewing directors and members of Senior Management. During the reporting period, the co-operation of external supervisors with directors and members of Senior Management was 100%. Through multiple channels of communication, the Board of Supervisors enhanced coordination with and recognition of the Board of Directors and Senior Management with the works of the Board of Supervisors, effectively improving the supervisory environment, and improving effectiveness of the work of the Board of Supervisors.

### 3. Conduct evaluation of performance of Supervisor duties.

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors, in accordance with the Measures of Guangxi Beibu Gulf Bank Co., Ltd. on Evaluation of Performance of Supervisors' Duties, established daily work files of Supervisors, required Supervisors to submit annual briefing reports, and encouraged Supervisors to actively propose suggestions. In combination with these work files of the Supervisors, Supervisors' self-assessment, mutual assessment, and other information, the Board of Supervisors completed the annual evaluation and examination of performance of Supervisors' duties.

## 广西北部湾银行 2010 年年报

### 4. Enhance learning and improve quality

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors, through strengthened communication with regulatory authorities, helped Supervisors to grasp the regulatory requirements in a timely manner and understand the new economic and financial situation, organized Supervisors to participate in practical training courses held by intermediaries on the workings of commercial bank Boards of Supervisors and participating in lectures on governance of commercial banks given by well-known experts hired by the Bank, and invited the core management of the Bank's Risk Department to undergo training on "three measures and one guidance" issued by China Banking Regulatory Commission; organized supervisors to make exchanges and study with the Boards of Supervisors of the Bank of Nanjing, Zhejiang Bank, Bank of Chengdu, Guiyang Bank, the head office of Industrial and Commercial Bank, and the head office of Minsheng Bank, to continuously improve the work of our Board of Supervisors by drawing on the experience of other banks in the industry. From theory to practice, the Board of Supervisors comprehensively improved the capacity and level of performance of their duties, to lay a good foundation for the exercise of those duties.

(II) Hold meetings of the Board of Supervisors on time and carefully deliberate supervisory matters of the Board of Supervisors.

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors strengthened inspection and oversight over finance, risk and internal controls and held a total of 6 meetings throughout the year (including communication voting), including 4 regular meetings and 2 interim meetings. These meetings deliberated and adopted 30 proposals covering profits distribution plan, comprehensive business plan and finance budget, report of the Board of Supervisors on examination and evaluation of the performance of the duties of directors and senior management personnel, several special examinations, research plans, and work reports; listened to 11 reports on the implementation of the comprehensive business plan of the Bank, rectification of the problems disclosed through internal and external audit, internal control structure, and comprehensive risk management; discussed specific work arrangements of the Board of Supervisors; and formed resolutions on 28 motions. Supervisors attended all meetings of the Board of Supervisors. The rate of attendance in person was 94%.

(III) Implementation of in-depth special inspection and research, and promoting the healthy development of the Bank.

The Board of Supervisors organized and conducted special inspection and research activities focused on hot issues within the business management of the Bank.

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors conducted three special inspections, followed up and implemented the rectification of problems revealed by inspections, prepared examination reports and reported them to senior management. First, the Board of Supervisors conducted a special inspection of the implementation of the internal control and prevention system of the head office Administration Department and Operation Department. According to the problems identified by the inspection, the Board of Supervisors proposed three management recommendations and followed up and implemented the rectifications of the problems discovered in inspections. Second, the Board of Supervisors entrusted a special inspection of the rectification of the problems discovered at the on-site examination of accounting information quality in 2009 by the Financial Commissioner's Office of the autonomous region to the audit department of the Bank. The Board of Supervisors urged all branches and relevant departments under the head office to implement the rectifications to the body of problems discovered, to implement specific measures and correction timescales, and to effectively complete the rectification works. As of December 31, 2010, 9 problems had been rectified in 8 out of 11 categories and 2 problems in the remaining 3 categories had been basically resolved.

### 广西北部湾银行 2010 年年报

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors conducted three research projects, actively made suggestions on the promotion of the healthy development of the Bank, and proposed 15 management advice and recommendations, prepared research reports, and submitted them to Senior Management. First, the Board of Supervisors conducted an investigation into the business management since the establishment of Tiandong Village Bank, in particular management of internal controls and risk, which focused on advice to Tiandong Village Bank for the rectification for two risk notices and one regulatory opinion proposed by Bais Office, CBRC, and Tiandong Regulation Office from 2009 to 2010, and proposed 5 management recommendations for Tiandong Village Bank. Second, the Board of Supervisors conducted research into the Bank's internal control and risk prevention systems. From three different levels of corporate governance, department of head office, and branches, the Board of Supervisors, in combination with the rectification of those problems discovered by regulatory departments in examinations over the Bank since 2009, conducted in-depth exchanges with senior management and functional departments, pointed out seven problems in internal control and risk prevention within the Bank, and proposed 9 elements of management advice and suggestions on the management of the Bank. Third, undertook research on the branch implementation of "three measures and one guidance". The Board of Supervisors prompted Senior Management to summarize 24 problems in five categories in the process of implementing "three measures and one guidance" in a timely manner, prepared a unified guidance document for issue to the Bank, and helped grass-roots branches to solve practical problems.

(IV) Strengthen supervision over the performance of duties by the Board of Directors and Senior Management to enable the Board of Directors and members of Senior Management to diligently perform their duties.

The Board of Supervisors actively explored the methods of supervision and supervised compliance with laws and regulations, Articles of Association of the Bank, implementation of the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders, and the exercise of authorities and obligations by the Board of Directors, Senior Management, and members thereof.

1. Actively conduct supervision by attending various meetings as voting and nonvoting delegates.

During the reporting period, supervisors of the Bank attended two general meetings of shareholders and supervised convening of the meetings, legitimacy and compliance of the holding procedures, and voting for proposals at the meetings. The Board of Supervisors sent representatives to attend four board meetings as nonvoting delegates. Members of the Board of Supervisors, listened to discussions and speeches made by directors on proposals before the board meetings, paid attention to the deliberation process of the major decision-making issues, supervised implementation of resolutions, and ensured that the convening and holding of meetings and the various proposals were in accordance with the interests of shareholders and the bank. The Board of Supervisors sent representatives to attend 51 loan examination meetings, 18 finance examination meetings, office meetings of the President, and business meetings, as nonvoting delegates, mastered the management structure of the Bank, and supervised decision-making of Senior Management in the performance of their duties.

## 2. Take full advantage of internal and external audit results, regulatory advice and supervision resources of the Bank to determine the supervision focus.

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors overcame the problems of few members, limited work hours and the energy of part-time supervisors, took full advantage of the power of internal and external audits, fully utilized internal and external audit results, and carried out their duties of supervision and performance, in supervision. First, the Board of Supervisors focused on and collected the various supervisory views of regulatory departments in a timely manner, then tracked and urged the rectification and implementation of those problems; second, the Board of Supervisors maintained close communication and cooperation with the internal audit departments, sent audit reports to supervisors for review and approval in a timely manner, and entrusted special examination and inspection feedback to the internal audit department for key issues of concern; third, the Board of Supervisors examined the progress of audit projects conducted by external audit departments and evaluated the audit opinions and management proposals of the external audit department in a timely manner.

### 广西北部湾银行 2010 年年报

3. Evaluate performance of duties of the Board of Directors, Senior Management, and their members for the first time.

During the reporting period, in order to further strengthen the supervision and evaluation of the Board of Supervisors over the Board of Directors and Senior Management, the Board of Supervisors, on the basis of studies from outside parties and in combination with the current situation of the Bank, studied and formulated the Implementation Plan of Board of Supervisors for Examination and Evaluation of Performance of Duties of Directors and Senior Management Personnel in 2010. According to the plan, the Board of Supervisors, from early December 2010 to January 2011, explored and conducted an examination and evaluation of performance of duties of the Bank's directors and senior management in 2010, and formulated reports on this examination and evaluation of performance of duties. The implementation of this work was recognized and praised by regulatory departments.

### II. The evaluation views of the Board of Supervisors on matters of supervision

##### (I) Views on evaluation and supervision of business

During the reporting period, the Bank adhered to a rapid and good business philosophy, consciously worked to overcome unfavorable factors such as limited credit size, worked hard in business innovation, made timely adjustment of the business structure, vigorously developed capital business, bills business and micro-loan business, strove to create profit margins, and performed competently in respect of the business objectives. Total assets, total liabilities and net assets substantially increased; net assets per share and earnings per share increased, diligently safeguarded the interests of shareholders. The balance of deposits was 34.156 billion yuan, an increase of 10.733 billion yuan over the beginning of the year, up by 45.8%. The balance of loans was 17.205 billion yuan, an increase of 3.87 billion yuan over the beginning of the year, up by 29.03%. Intermediary business developed rapidly. Capital and bill business created income of 636 million yuan, with an increase of 441 million yuan, up by 226.15%. Income totaled 1.787 billion yuan, with an increase of 848 million yuan, up by 90.31%; net profit was 439 million yuan, with an increase of 241 million yuan, up by 122%.

The Board of Supervisors believes that: within the reporting period, the Bank operated in compliance with laws and regulations, strengthened internal management, and achieved optimum operational performance, fully completed the business objectives issued by the General Meeting of Shareholders, ensured the preservation of capital value, and safeguarded the rights and interests of shareholders. The members of the Board of Directors and Senior Management of the Bank seriously and diligently performed their duties. No violation of laws, regulations or Articles of Association or other cases that might damage the interests of shareholders and the Bank were found in the performance of the duties of the Board of Directors and Senior Management.

##### (II) Views on evaluation and supervision of finance

##### (III) Views on evaluation and supervision of core supervision indicators

##### (IV) Views on evaluation and supervision of internal control

The Board of Supervisors, after careful consideration, made the resolution to accept the proposal of the Board of Directors to hire PricewaterhouseCoopers to audit the financial statements of the Bank for 2010. PricewaterhouseCoopers Certified Public Accountants Co., Ltd. conducted an audit and issued a standard unqualified audit report, in accordance with national and international auditing standards.

The Board of Supervisors, after examination, believes that: the financial reports of the Bank for 2010 are a true, fair and complete reflection of the Bank's financial position and operating results. And that the audit report is true and objective.

The Board of Supervisors, after due consideration, believes that as of December 31, 2010, the Bank's core supervisory indicators, excepting core liability dependence, are within the regulatory standards.

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors believes that the Bank has comprehensively strengthened the construction of the system, has further established and improved internal control systems, has continuously improved internal control management levels, and has achieved good results.

### 广西北部湾银行 2010 年年报

(V) Views on evaluation and supervision of the implementation of the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors found no objection to the various reports and proposals submitted by the Board of Directors to the General Meeting of Shareholders for deliberation, has supervised the implementation of the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders, and believes that the Board of Directors of the Bank is able to seriously implement the relevant resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.

##### (VI) Views on evaluation and supervision of related party transactions

The Bank's related party transactions are mainly related to bank deposits and lending business.

During the reporting period, the Bank had one significant related party transaction; the Bank granted credit of 340 million yuan to Liuzhou Iron & Steel Company Ltd. with a credit period of one year. Guangxi Liuzhou Iron & Steel (Group) Company provided a guarantee of joint and several responsibility. The varieties of credit include working capital loans, bank acceptances, import L/C and import negotiation, of which, the credit of working capital loans or bank acceptance (exposure limit) is 100 million yuan; and credit of domestic L/C, import L/C, and import negotiation issued is 240 million yuan. The related party transaction was, upon authorization by the Board of Directors, approved by the Related Party Transactions Committee under the Board of Directors.

Upon examination by the Board of Supervisors, the Bank, in respect of related party transactions, strictly followed the relevant provisions to implement the procedures of related party transactions. The transaction fully reflected the "fair, open and just" market principle. And no damage to the interests of shareholders or the Bank was found.

##### (VII) Independent opinion on profit distribution plan

Upon deliberation by the Board of Supervisors, the Board of Supervisors agreed with the profit distribution plan of the Bank for 2010 prepared by the Board of Directors.

##### (VIII) Views on supervision of major investments

During the reporting period, upon examination by the Board of Supervisors, the Bank had a total of one major investment. Specifically: the Bank, upon consent by General Meeting of Shareholders and approval by the Guangxi Supervision Bureau, invested 25.5 million yuan to fund the establishment of Binyang Beibu Gulf Village Bank Co., Ltd., as the main sponsor. Currently, the village bank is under preparation for construction.

##### (IX) Views on evaluation and supervision of other transactions

Within the reporting period, upon examination by the Board of Supervisors, the Bank did not sell any assets and had no insider trading. No damage to the interests of shareholders and the Company was found.

### III. Work plan of the Board of Supervisors for 2011

In 2011, the general idea of the Bank's Board of Supervisors is to center on the power conferred by the Company Law and the Articles of Association, to actively innovate new supervision and evaluation ways on the basis of a comprehensive summary of the working experiences of the Board of Supervisors in the two years since its establishment, to strive to make new breakthroughs in the supervision and evaluation of the performance of duties of the directors and senior management, to create new achievements in supervision and evaluation of finance, internal control, risk, and compliance management of the Bank, to form a more smooth communication mechanism with the Board of Directors and Senior Management, to more actively report works to the General Meeting of Shareholders, standardize the operations of the Board of Supervisors, and to promote the effectiveness of corporate governance supervision mechanism.

(i) To further streamline and improve the institutional system of the Board of Supervisors, and standardize the operational mechanisms of the Board of Supervisors. On the basis of learning from the working experiences of the Board of Supervisors of other banks and streamlining the systems of the Board of Supervisors of the Bank by Wei Heng Law Firm, to further establish and improve the Bank's system of Board of Supervisors.

### 广西北部湾银行 2010 年年报

(II) To improve the organizational structure of the Board of Supervisors and to further enhance the functions of the two special committees under the Board of Supervisors. The Board of Supervisors will rename the Audit Committee as Supervision Committee, streamline the responsibilities of the Nomination Committee and the Supervision Committee, and further develop the functions of the two special committees.

(III) To standardize the manner in which the Board of Supervisors performs its duties, and standardize the procedure and formats of special inspection reports, investigation reports, duty performance evaluation reports, questions, visits, interview transcripts, power of attorney, reminders, comments, and proposals. The Board of Supervisors will standardize the information reporting and materials to be submitted by the Board of Directors and senior management thereto.

(IV) During the year, it plans to conduct the following special inspections. First, to carry out a special inspection of the market risk management position; Second, to carry out inspection of the implementation of resolutions by the Board of Directors over financial issues in 2010; Third, to carry out inspection and evaluation of the performance of duties of the Board of Directors, Senior Management, and members thereof in 2011.

(V) During the year, to conduct research activities. First, to research the compliance management of the Bank; Second, to research the internal control of branch management; Third, to research the implementation of the approval opinions of the head office loan approval meeting.

To ensure the successful completion of the abovementioned objectives, in 2011, the Bank's Board of Supervisors will strengthen its own construction and effectively improve the supervision level of the Board of Supervisors. First, by strengthening the independence of the Board of Supervisors, examining its own quality controls, exploring duty performance modes of the Board of Supervisors, finding problems at the front line, and independently exercising supervision and accountability, to realize the ultimate goal of, start with servicing to realize supervision; second, to further clarify the responsibilities of the two special committees under the Board of Supervisors, to clarify the responsibilities and labor division of external supervisors, shareholder supervisors, and employee supervisors in the two special committees, to give full play to the functions of the two special committees and the Office of the Board of Supervisors, to fully mobilize enthusiasm in the supervisors and workers of the Office of the Board of Supervisors, and to safeguard effective development of the work of the Bank's Board of Supervisors; third, to strengthen the training of supervisors, to strive for more support and guidance and to adopt the way of "going out and inviting" by strengthening communication with the higher regulatory authorities to improve supervisors' independent analysis capacity, capability and level of supervision by organizing supervisors of the Bank to conduct exchanges with domestic counterparts, and to enhance the level of overall supervision of the Board of Supervisors.

We sincerely hope to hear the views of you, our distinguished shareholders.
